en: A black‑and‑white winter view of a historic hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires, attached to a long palace-like building. Below the hill lies a town with snow-covered roofs and a river with ice floes in the foreground. People walk along the riverside embankment. The photo has a white border with deckled edges, a handwritten number "27576" at the top right, and the printed caption "Meissen im Winter" at the bottom right.
